# The Sunday Times quotes Christopher Bogart about PACCAR


April 5, 2025


-
-
-
-


*The Sunday Times* quotes Burford CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) about the current state of legal finance in the UK, where Bogart states that the sector is "shrouded in a 'fog of uncertainty'" and as a result, Burford is "choosing to invest in other jurisdictions."


[Click here to read the full article.](https://www.thetimes.com/article/690c938e-91f1-45ae-80c6-125527b3078c)
